sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

This means that players must think creatively and strategically to find the most efficient solution.

As players progress through the levels, the equations become increasingly complex, requiring players to think critically and use advanced problem-solving skills. The game also introduces new mathematical concepts and operations, such as exponents, roots, and fractions, further increasing the challenge and difficulty.

One of the most unique features of Mathematics is its use of a 'time' mechanic. Players have a limited amount of time to solve each equation, adding an extra layer of pressure and challenge to the game. This mechanic also encourages players to think quickly and efficiently, making the game more engaging and fast-paced.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Mathematics are engaging, challenging, and addictive. The game's focus on mental math and problem-solving skills makes it a unique and compelling experience that will keep players coming back for more.
